find.empty.otherArea.title: We don't have listings for your area yet

listing.notFound: This listing could not be found.
profile.title: Collector profile
profile.noContact.title: Contact details not connected
profile.noContact.body: This sample has no real phone number. No call or booking can be made from this listing.
profile.contactNote: You arrange the time and price directly with the collector. SetSetal doesn't take part in the call or the payment.
profile.noContactReal.title: No contact details yet
profile.noContactReal.body: This collector hasn't shared a phone number for residents.
profile.report: Report a problem with this listing
join.title: Register your service
join.intro: Sign in with your phone number, then tell residents what you collect and where.
join.name: Name or business name
join.waste.error: Choose at least one waste type.
join.consent: Show my phone and WhatsApp numbers to residents once my listing is approved.
join.error.phone: Enter the phone number as 7 digits, or in full starting with +.
join.error.lists: Please choose a vehicle from the list.
join.signin.title: Sign in with your phone
join.signin.body: We'll text you a 6-digit code. You don't need a password.
join.signin.error.phone: Enter a Gambian number as 7 digits, or a full number starting with +.
join.signin.error.unavailable: Sign-in isn't available yet. Please try again later.
join.signin.error.offline: You seem to be offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
join.signin.error.invalidPhone: We couldn't send a code to that number. Check it and try again.
join.signin.error.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check it and try again, or ask for a new one.
join.signin.error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
join.signin.error.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
join.signin.sharedNote: On a shared phone, sign out when you finish.
join.whatsappPlaceholder: Leave empty if you don't use WhatsApp
join.areas.loadError: We couldn't load the list of areas. Check your connection and try again.
join.consentNote: Without this, residents can see your listing but can't contact you. You can change it at any time.
join.reviewNote: An admin checks every listing before residents can see it.
join.error.whatsapp: Enter the WhatsApp number as 7 digits, or in full starting with +, or leave it empty.
join.status.title: Your listing
join.status.submittedBody: An admin will check your listing. Residents can't see it yet.
join.status.approvedNoConsent: Residents can't contact you, because you haven't agreed to show your numbers. Edit your listing to change this.
join.status.rejectedBody: Edit your listing and it will be checked again.
join.status.suspendedBody: Residents can't see your listing. Contact the SetSetal team if you think this is a mistake.
join.status.editNote: An admin checks new names, vehicles, descriptions, numbers, areas and waste types before residents see them. Removing an area or hiding your numbers takes effect straight away.
join.status.loadError: We couldn't load your listing. Check your connection and try again.
join.status.suspendedEditNote: Your listing stays hidden while it's suspended, even if you edit it.
preview.title: Your listing preview
preview.reviewNote: An admin checks new details before residents see them. Removing an area or hiding your numbers takes effect straight away.
preview.error.offline: You seem to be offline, so your listing hasn't been sent. Connect and try again.
preview.error.signedOut: You've been signed out. Sign in again and resubmit.
preview.error.invalid: SetSetal couldn't accept these details. Go back, check them and try again.
preview.error.failed: Something went wrong and your listing hasn't been sent. Please try again later.
preview.error.unknown: We couldn't confirm whether your listing was saved. Go back to check its status before trying again.
preview.savedLive: Saved. Your listing is still live.
preview.savedUnchanged: Saved, but nothing that needs review has changed, so it hasn't been checked again. Update the details the admin mentioned.
preview.savedSuspended: Saved. Your listing is still suspended; contact the SetSetal team.
help.title: Help and feedback
help.using.title: Using SetSetal
help.using.body: Choose your area, filter by vehicle, and open a listing to see its service details. Confirm price and pickup arrangements directly with the provider.
help.using.demo: Listings in this prototype are demonstration examples, not confirmed real services.
help.using.real: Listings appear only after the SetSetal team has reviewed them. Agree the time and price directly with the collector.
help.report.title: Send feedback
help.report.privacy: Your feedback goes to the SetSetal team. Don't include your address or phone number: we don't ask who you are, so we can't reply.
help.report.sent.title: Feedback sent
help.report.sent.body: Thank you. The SetSetal team will review it.
help.report.queued.title: Saved on this phone, not sent yet
help.report.queued.body: We couldn't reach SetSetal just now. It's saved on this phone and will be sent automatically when you're back online. If it can't be sent within 30 days, it will be deleted.
help.report.failed.title: Feedback not sent
help.report.flushed.one: Your saved feedback has been sent.
help.report.flushed.other: {count} saved feedback messages have been sent.
help.report.emptyMessage: Please write a few words about what happened.
help.report.sentUnlinked.title: Feedback sent
help.report.sentUnlinked.body: That listing is no longer shown, so we sent your feedback without linking it.
help.report.failed.body: We couldn't reach SetSetal or save it on this phone. Your text is still in the form, so please try again later.
help.report.rejected.title: Feedback not sent
help.report.rejected.body: SetSetal couldn't accept this feedback. Check the details and try again.
help.report.unavailable.title: Feedback not sent
help.report.unavailable.body: This version of the app can't send feedback.
help.report.dropped: Some saved feedback couldn't be sent and was removed.
